title: Chapter 9: The Eastern Wasteland
paragraphs: "Young brother, what are you doing in my master's Cave Abode?"
The eldest of the group, the first to regain his composure, raised a Black Flag in his hand and asked with a furrowed brow.
Chen Mobai inwardly cursed his misfortune, a sheepish expression creeping across his face.

Within the Immortal Sect, it was forbidden to probe another cultivator's cultivation level without their permission. Though he couldn't ascertain their exact realms, the fluctuations of Spiritual Power suggested they were roughly on par with his own.
Moreover, the way the elder and his younger companion had entered the Cave Abode clearly indicated they possessed the correct key.

Though Chen Mobai had stumbled into the Water Abode by accident, he had nonetheless occupied this precious cultivation site for several days. Being caught red-handed by the disciples of the rightful owner left him feeling distinctly awkward.
"Elder, please forgive my intrusion. I entered by accident and will leave immediately."

Chen Mobai turned to depart, but noticing the strained, unfamiliar distance between the elder and his younger companion as they entered the Water Abode, a sudden thought flashed through his mind, freezing him in place.
"So, that's how it is. The Azure Water Grand Formation shows no signs of damage. If the young brother says he stumbled in by accident, it must be true."

The old man waved the Black Flag in his hand, inspected the Grand Formation protecting the entire Cave Abode, and confirmed the integrity of the Restrictions on the three side halls. He let out a sigh of relief and nodded at Chen Mobai.
"This old man will now deactivate the formation. Young brother, you may leave."

As he spoke, Chen Mobai saw a two-meter-diameter hole materialize in the protective barrier enveloping the Water Abode, right at the entrance of the Front Hall. Yet the surrounding water didn't rush in, as if held back by an invisible force.
Under the watchful gaze of the elder and the youth, their intentions clear in ushering him out, Chen Mobai suppressed his doubts, nodded lightly, and stepped between them toward the opening.

Just as Chen Mobai was about to cross the threshold of the barrier, a cyan radiance erupted from his clenched fist like spilled ink, coalescing into a full-body Wood Armor that completely enveloped him.
Thud! Thud! Thud!
Three yellowish-brown needles materialized out of nowhere, their tips glowing with a dim, amber light, and pierced the Wood Armor protecting Chen Mobai's chest.
"So trespassing on private property warrants such a vicious attack? Where's the justice in this world?!"
Chen Mobai whirled around, his eyes blazing with fury. He saw the plain-faced youth holding a Needle Case in one hand, forming a hand seal with the other, his eyes cold as ice.
On Diyuan Star, ruled by the Immortal Sect, the legal system inherited from the previous civilization remained in force.
Murder was a grave crime.
If Chen Mobai hadn't preemptively activated his Wood Armor Talisman, which automatically triggered upon being attacked, he would have perished on the spot.
"Attack now!"

Seeing his magical artifact blocked and Chen Mobai's "murderous aura" intensifying, the brown-robed youth feared the man might resort to desperate, mutually destructive tactics. Though he had reached the Sixth Layer of Qi Refinement, he didn't want to waste too much spiritual power before breaking through the Restriction.
As he drew three more long needles from his Needle Case, he shouted at the old man.
"Very well! Witness my Divine Thunder!"
The old man roared in response, a fierce glint flashing in his eyes. With a flick of his Black Flag, he waved it toward Chen Mobai, then tossed a deep blue Talisman Paper from his sleeve.
But the Talisman Paper wasn't aimed at Chen Mobai; it was directed at the brown-robed youth himself.

A thunderous crack split the air. The youth cursed furiously, then forcibly reversed his spiritual power, redirecting the flying needles he had been preparing to launch at Chen Mobai toward the old man instead.
Amid Chen Mobai's utter confusion, the old man's Divine Thunder struck the brown-robed youth, who collapsed, his face contorted in bitter resentment.
Meanwhile, the old man waved his Black Flag, manipulating the power of the Water Abode Formation to block the youth's flying needles.
Ding, ding, ding!The flying needles clattered against the stone tiles, their sharp tips piercing straight into the ground, a testament to their lethal precision.
"Hahaha! You dare to claim an equal share of this Secret Realm's treasures with this old man, relying on your third-rate inheritance from the Flying Needle Sect? This is the lawless Eastern Barrens!"

The old man roared with laughter, waving his Black Flag once more to unleash the Azure Water Grand Formation. He aimed to crush Chen Mobai, but the power of the latter's Wood Armor Talisman had yet to fully dissipate, blocking the surging waves of water.
Where exactly is this place? The Eastern Barrens? I've never heard of such a name among the Thirty-Six Grotto-Heavens and Seventy-Two Blessed Lands of the Immortal Sects.

Chen Mobai had been reeling from the shock of the old man and the youth's ruthless betrayal, but the searing heat as the Wood Armor Talisman's spiritual power drained and began to burn jolted him back to reality.
He couldn't gauge the old man's cultivation, but the Black Flag in his hand was the core of the Water Abode Grand Formation, granting him control over its full power.

Though the Azure Water Grand Formation lacked direct offensive capabilities, if Chen Mobai were trapped, enduring even a single strike from a Thunder Talisman like the brown-robed youth, his fate would be sealed—dead beyond redemption.
At this life-or-death moment, Chen Mobai acted without hesitation, unleashing the Azure Arrow Talisman he had long prepared.
Whoosh... Whoosh... Whoosh...
Five azure arrows materialized from thin air like vines, converging with astonishing speed on the old man's position.

"Hmph, outside the Water Abode, I would have retreated a mile," the old man chuckled, confidently waving the Black Flag in his hand. The Azure Water Grand Formation activated, sending out invisible ripples that froze the four arrows hovering before him in mid-air.
"You little whelp, how did you even reach the Fifth-Stage of Qi Refinement with such terrible aim?"
Just as the old man was about to seal the cave entrance, trapping Chen Mobai completely, his expression froze.

He realized the Azure Water Grand Formation had fallen out of his control. The shimmering barrier that had been closing halted, leaving the entrance open. Yet Chen Mobai, who could have escaped through it, remained at the threshold, drawing two more Azure Arrow Talismans as he glared coldly at the old man.
How did this brat figure out this Controlling Array Flag governs defense?the old man wondered, his heart trembling as he glanced around.
It dawned on him that the four Spiritual Energy arrows from Chen Mobai's first Azure Arrow Talisman had been a feint—a distraction to draw his attention.
Another arrow, seemingly misfired, landed perfectly on one of the array bases nearby, snapping the array flag planted there.
Though the Azure Water Grand Formation was a second-tier formation, it offered no defense against attacks originating from within.

Having thoroughly explored the Water Abode beforehand, Chen Mobai exploited this weakness. By disabling a corner of the array, he immediately disrupted the once-smooth operation of the Grand Formation, causing it to seize up.
The old man's face turned ashen. He glanced at the three side halls behind the Water Abode, but sensing that Chen Mobai's talisman was about to activate, he gritted his teeth and prepared to retreat.
His cultivation base was merely at the Third Layer of Qi Refinement.
Without the Black Flag, the central control mechanism for the Azure Water Grand Formation, he would never have dared to confront the brown-robed youth and Chen Mobai alone.

But just as he was about to flee, the sky flashed with azure light. Both Azure Arrow Talismans in Chen Mobai's hands had been activated, materializing ten Spiritual Energy arrows that hovered in the air, aimed directly at the old man.
"Young friend, no—Senior, spare me!"
